identity.name: Lead Testing
identity.description: A lead hazard assessment helps identify potential exposure risks from lead-based materials, contaminated water systems, or hazardous environmental conditions within residential properties.
identity.legal_reference: Housing health, environmental safety, and hazard management obligations relating to potential lead exposure risks in residential properties.

action_links.label: NHS guidance on lead exposure risks

entry.why_it_matters_short: Exposure to lead hazards can create serious health risks, particularly for children and vulnerable occupants living in older residential properties.
entry.why_it_matters_long: Lead hazards may exist in older properties through materials such as historic lead-based paint, contaminated dust, or older plumbing systems. Assessments and testing can help identify potential exposure risks and support appropriate remediation or safety measures where necessary.

SCOTLAND.short: Lead hazard assessments may help identify health risks in older Scottish residential properties.
SCOTLAND.long: Older residential properties in Scotland may contain lead-related hazards that could affect occupant health and require assessment or remediation measures.

governance.change_reason: Published Scotland-specific lead hazard assessment requirement with age-based applicability logic for higher-risk residential properties.
governance.internal_notes: Requirement intentionally scoped to higher-risk older properties where lead exposure hazards may be more likely.
governance.legal_source_summary: Lead exposure hazards in residential properties may require investigation or remediation where occupant health risks are identified.
